## AI-assisted change checklist

- [ ] Plan written in `docs/plans/` and approved before coding
- [ ] `npm run check` passes (typecheck, lint, format, tests)
- [ ] `architecture-reviewer` subagent run — verdict: <!-- ready / needs changes -->
- [ ] New tools/behaviour have unit tests
- [ ] No edits to `evals/cases/` that weaken expectations (or explained below)
- [ ] Prompt changed? New version file + eval results below
- [ ] Architecture decision? ADR added in `docs/decisions/`
- [ ] Plan in `docs/plans/` marked done, with results
- [ ] I read the whole diff myself
